object.attr: The app reconnects to the paired sensor in later sessions without a new scan. The connection type is Bluetooth LE or ANT+, and the name is kept when the sensor reports one. The address is the Bluetooth address for Bluetooth LE and the device number for ANT+. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: When the user selects a heart rate sensor in Settings, the app shall retain the connection type, the address or device number, and the name of that sensor as the paired sensor.
